prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a parking lot collision. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1198; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage does not match the story: the dents are on another side and at another height than the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: The vehicle presents a rear quarter panel dent and a bumper cover crack, with secondary scuffing along the lower door edge. The dent location sits on the opposite side and at a higher point than the impact described in the claim, so the damage pattern and the reported account do not line up, and this should be reviewed before payment. Repair billing shows no repeated line items, and the labor hours requested are consistent with the work needed on these panels. Nothing in our records or the vehicle history indicates earlier damage to these areas. Recommended plan: replace the bumper cover, repair the quarter panel, refinish affected surfaces, and recheck after the first-stage teardown.
